final: WITH hand_shares AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS winner_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(hs.winner_count) AS combined_tally, AVG(hs.share) AS average_share, AVG(hs.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share FROM hand_shares AS hs CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE hs.share > a.avg_share
